title: Disclosure Event v1
description: Content-light disclosure event appended to the durable disclosure-event ledger when a disclosure transition completes. Each event is deduplicated by transition_id. Never contains raw source code, secrets, file paths beyond stable identifiers, or unbounded error strings. Lane A owns this event domain.

event_id.description: Stable disclosure-event identity. Derived from transition_id.

authorization_id.description: Governance disclosure authorization identifier used for this event.

authorization_receipt_sha256.description: SHA256 digest of the governance authorization receipt consumed for this disclosure. May be empty string if receipt not yet loaded.

evidence_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the opaque evidence object (candidate ZIP bundle). Accepts raw or sha256: prefixed hex.

projection_id.description: Review projection identifier bound to this disclosure.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp bound by the transition plan at PREPARED time.

outcome.description: Disclosure outcome. Always 'authorized' for durably recorded events.

transition_id.description: Parent disclosure transition identifier. Acts as deduplication key.

manifest_digest_before.description: SHA256 digest of the protected-content manifest before selector mutation. Present when manifest was loaded.

manifest_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the protected-content manifest at event time. Present when manifest was loaded.

selector_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the disclosed selector identity, if a scoped selector disclosure was authorized.

selector_disclosed.description: True when a scoped selector was disclosed in this event.

manifest_digest_after.description: SHA256 digest of the manifest after the selector disclosure mutation was applied.
